question: How do I send money at a branch?
answer: Bring a valid ID, fill in the send form with the receiver's full name and mobile number, pay the amount plus the fee, and send the receiver the 10-character reference number from the receipt.

question: Can I send money using the app?
answer: Yes: tap Send, choose branch pickup or wallet, enter the receiver's details and the amount, and confirm with your 6-digit PIN; the reference number is on the last screen.

question: What hours does support answer chats?
answer: A person answers chats every day from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

question: How much is the fee to send ₱800 for branch pickup?
answer: ₱15, the fee for amounts up to ₱1,000.

question: What does it cost to send ₱12,000 for pickup?
Is sending to another wallet free?
answer: It is free up to ₱10,000 a day; above that, the fee is ₱10 per transfer.

question: What's the most I can send in one branch transfer?
answer: ₱50,000; to send more, make another transfer on a later day or ask at a branch.

question: What is the fee for sending 30,000 pesos for pickup?
What do I need to claim money sent to me?
answer: The 10-character reference number and one valid ID with your photo; the name on the ID must match the receiver's name.

question: How long can money wait at a branch before it goes back?
answer: 30 days; after that it is returned to the sender.

question: The sender misspelled my name. Can I still claim the money?
answer: Not yet: the sender must first change the receiver's name at a branch.

question: Can I change the receiver's name after sending?
answer: Yes, once and for free, at any branch, before the money is claimed; bring the receipt and your ID.

question: If I cancel a transfer, do I get the fee back?
answer: The amount is returned in full; the fee is returned only if you cancel on the same day you sent it.

question: I sent money to the wrong wallet. Can I cancel it in the app?
answer: No, a wallet transfer can't be cancelled in the app; contact support with the reference number, and never send your PIN or OTP to anyone offering to reverse it.

question: What does Pending mean on a transfer?
answer: The transfer is being checked; most finish within 15 minutes.

question: A transfer has been pending for 3 hours. What should I do?
answer: Contact support with the reference number, and don't send it again, since a second transfer could charge you twice.

question: Should I send the money again if it's still pending?
answer: No, a second transfer could charge you twice; if it's still Pending after 2 hours, contact support.

question: How do I pay a bill in the app?
answer: Tap Bills, choose the biller, enter your account number with that biller and the amount, confirm with your PIN, and keep the reference number.

question: Is there a fee to pay bills at a branch?
answer: Yes, a ₱10 service fee at the counter.

question: Is paying bills in the app free?
answer: Free for most billers; some billers add their own fee, shown before you confirm.

question: How long before an electricity payment reaches the biller?
answer: Within 1 banking day.

question: When does a credit card payment reach the bank?
answer: Within 3 banking days.

question: How many days before the due date should I pay a bill?
answer: At least 3 days before the due date.

question: Can you remove a late fee that my biller charged?
answer: No, Halimbawa Money can't cancel penalties a biller charges for a late payment.

question: Can I pay school tuition through you?
answer: Yes, schools are among the billers you can pay; the full list is in the app under Bills.

question: My biller isn't in the list. What can I do?
answer: You can't pay it through Halimbawa Money yet; tell support which biller you need, since the list is updated every month.

question: What kind of items can I pawn?
answer: Items of value such as gold jewellery or a watch.

question: What do I need to bring to pawn something?
answer: The item and one valid ID.

question: Why should I keep my pawn ticket?
answer: It shows the loan amount, interest, due date and item, and you need it to renew the loan or get the item back.

question: How much can I borrow against gold jewellery?
answer: Usually up to 70% of the appraised value.

question: What is the interest on a pawn loan?
answer: 3% of the loan each month, counted from the day of the loan; part of a month counts as a full month.

question: Is there a service charge when I renew a pawn loan?
answer: Yes, a ₱5 service charge.

question: How do I renew a pawn loan?
answer: Bring your pawn ticket to any branch or renew in the app under Pawn with the ticket number, paying the interest due and the service charge.

question: How many times can I renew a pawn loan?
answer: Up to 4 times.

question: Can I pay part of the loan when I renew?
answer: Yes; next month's interest is then counted on the smaller amount.

question: How do I get my pawned item back?
answer: Bring the pawn ticket and your ID to the branch where you pawned it and pay the loan, the interest and the service charge.

question: Can my sister redeem my pawned item for me?
answer: Yes, with your pawn ticket, a letter signed by you, a copy of your ID and her own ID.

question: Is there a grace period after the pawn due date?
answer: Yes, 90 days to redeem or renew, with interest still counted each month.

question: When does an unredeemed item go to auction?
answer: If the loan isn't redeemed or renewed by the end of the 90-day grace period, the item may be sold at a public auction.

question: Will I be told before my item is auctioned?
answer: Yes, a text message goes to the mobile number on the pawn ticket before the auction date, and you can redeem until the day before.

question: Can I get my item back after it is sold at auction?
answer: No, once an item is sold it can't be returned.

question: I lost my pawn ticket. What should I do?
answer: Go to the branch where you pawned the item with a valid ID, report it and fill in an affidavit of loss; a new ticket is issued after 3 banking days for ₱50.

question: How much can a verified wallet receive each month?
answer: Up to ₱100,000; the limit starts again on the first day of the month.

question: What do I need to sign up for the wallet?
answer: A mobile number that can receive texts, an email address and one valid photo ID; you must be at least 18.

question: Can I have two wallets on one mobile number?
answer: No, one mobile number can have only one wallet.

question: The sign-up won't finish. What should I check?
answer: That the app is up to date and your internet is steady; if your number already has a wallet, log in instead.

question: Why should I verify my ID?
answer: A verified wallet can send money, pay bills and hold up to ₱100,000; an unverified one can only receive money and hold up to ₱5,000.

question: How long does ID verification take?
answer: Most checks finish within 24 hours.

question: My ID verification was rejected. What should I do?
answer: Make sure the whole ID is in the photo, not blurry and without glare, take the selfie in good light without a cap or glasses, and try again, up to 3 times a day.

question: Can I use my school ID to verify?
answer: No; school IDs, company IDs and barangay certificates aren't accepted.

question: Is a postal ID accepted?
answer: Yes, as long as it isn't expired.

question: What should I do if my OTP doesn't arrive?
answer: Wait 2 minutes, then tap Resend; check your signal and that your SIM is the one registered to your wallet. An OTP expires after 5 minutes.

question: How long is an OTP valid?
answer: 5 minutes.

question: Will Halimbawa Money ever ask for my OTP?
answer: No, never; anyone who asks for it is trying to take your money.

question: I forgot my PIN. How do I reset it?
answer: Tap Forgot PIN on the login screen, enter the OTP sent to your registered number, take a selfie, then set a new PIN.

question: How many wrong PIN tries lock the wallet?
answer: 5 wrong tries lock it for 24 hours.

question: Is cashing in at a branch free?
answer: Free up to ₱8,000 a month; after that, ₱10 per cash-in.

question: How much is the fee to cash out at a branch?
answer: ₱20 per cash-out.

question: My cash-out code expired. What now?
answer: Make a new one in the app; the money stays in your wallet.

question: Are branches open on Sundays?
answer: Most branches are open Monday to Saturday; branches in malls follow mall hours, usually 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., every day.

question: Paano magpadala ng pera sa branch?
answer: Magdala ng valid ID, punan ang send form, bayaran ang halaga at fee, at ibigay sa receiver ang reference number.

question: Magkano ang fee pag nagpadala ng ₱4,000 for pickup?
Libre ba ang padala sa ibang wallet?
answer: Libre hanggang ₱10,000 kada araw; lampas doon, ₱10 kada transfer.

question: Hanggang magkano ang pwede kong ipadala sa isang branch transfer?
Ano ang kailangan para ma-claim ang padala sa akin?
answer: Ang 10-character reference number at isang valid ID na may litrato, na tugma ang pangalan.

question: Gaano katagal pwedeng hindi kunin ang padala sa branch?
answer: 30 araw; pagkatapos ay ibinabalik sa nagpadala.

question: Pwede bang palitan ang pangalan ng receiver?
answer: Oo, isang beses at libre, sa branch, bago makuha ang pera.

question: Kung i-cancel ko ang padala, babalik ba ang fee?
answer: Buong halaga ang ibinabalik; ang fee ay kung sa parehong araw ka nag-cancel.

question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng Pending sa transfer?
answer: Sinusuri pa ito; karamihan ay natatapos sa loob ng 15 minuto.

question: Dapat ko bang ulitin ang padala kung Pending pa?
answer: Hindi, baka masingil ka nang dalawang beses; kung Pending pa pagkalipas ng 2 oras, kontakin ang support.

question: Paano magbayad ng bills sa app?
answer: I-tap ang Bills, piliin ang biller, ilagay ang account number sa biller at halaga, at kumpirmahin gamit ang PIN.

question: May bayad ba ang pagbayad ng bills sa branch?
answer: Oo, ₱10 na service fee.

question: Kailan papasok sa biller ang bayad ko sa tubig?
answer: Sa loob ng 1 banking day.

question: Ilang araw bago ang due date dapat magbayad ng bill?
answer: Hindi bababa sa 3 araw bago ang due date.

question: Pwede ba magbayad ng tuition sa school?
answer: Oo, kasama ang mga school sa mga biller.

question: Wala sa listahan ang biller ko, ano ang gagawin ko?
answer: Hindi pa ito mababayaran; sabihin sa support ang biller na kailangan mo; ina-update ang listahan buwan-buwan.

question: Paano po mag-sangla ng alahas?
answer: Dalhin ang alahas at isang valid ID sa branch; titingnan ito ng appraiser at bibigyan ka ng pera at pawn ticket.

question: Magkano ang pwede kong mahiram sa ginto?
answer: Karaniwan hanggang 70% ng appraised value.

question: Magkano ang interest kada buwan sa sangla?
answer: 3% ng loan kada buwan.

question: Paano i-renew ang sangla?
answer: Dalhin ang pawn ticket sa branch o i-renew sa app sa Pawn, at bayaran ang interest at service charge.

question: Ilang beses pwedeng i-renew ang sangla?
answer: Hanggang 4 na beses.

question: Paano tubusin ang alahas na isinangla?
answer: Dalhin ang pawn ticket at ID sa branch kung saan isinangla at bayaran ang loan, interest at service charge.

question: Pwede bang ibang tao ang tumubos ng alahas ko?
answer: Oo, dala ang pawn ticket, sulat na pirmado mo, kopya ng ID mo at sarili niyang ID.

question: Gaano katagal ang grace period pagkatapos ng due date ng sangla?
answer: 90 araw.

question: Ano ang mangyayari kung hindi ko natubos ang item?
answer: Pagkatapos ng 90-day grace period, maaaring ibenta ito sa public auction.

question: Nawala ko yung pawn ticket, ano gagawin ko?
answer: Pumunta sa branch na may ID, i-report at punan ang affidavit of loss; may bagong ticket pagkalipas ng 3 banking days sa halagang ₱50.

question: Paano mag sign up sa wallet?
answer: I-download ang app, i-tap ang Sign up, ilagay ang mobile number at OTP, at gumawa ng 6-digit PIN; pagkatapos ay i-verify ang ID.

question: Ilang taon dapat para makapag sign up sa wallet?
answer: Hindi bababa sa 18 taong gulang.

question: Bakit na-reject ang ID verification ko?
answer: Siguraduhing buo, malinaw at walang glare ang litrato ng ID, at maliwanag ang selfie nang walang cap o salamin; pwedeng subukan ulit hanggang 3 beses kada araw.

question: Gaano katagal ang ID verification?
answer: Karamihan ay natatapos sa loob ng 24 oras.

question: Tinatanggap ba ang school ID?
answer: Hindi; hindi tinatanggap ang school ID, company ID at barangay certificate.

question: Pwede ba ang driver's license sa verification?
answer: Oo, basta hindi expired.

question: Hindi dumating ang OTP ko, ano ang gagawin ko?
answer: Maghintay ng 2 minuto at i-tap ang Resend; tingnan ang signal at kung rehistradong SIM ang gamit.

question: Hihingin ba ng Halimbawa Money ang OTP ko?
answer: Hindi kailanman; ang humihingi nito ay gustong kunin ang pera mo.

question: Nakalimutan ko ang PIN ko, paano ito i-reset?
answer: I-tap ang Forgot PIN, ilagay ang OTP, mag-selfie, at gumawa ng bagong PIN.

question: Bakit kaya naka-lock ang wallet pag mali ang PIN?
answer: Ang 5 beses na maling PIN ay nagla-lock ng wallet nang 24 oras.

question: Libre ba mag cash in sa branch?
answer: Libre hanggang ₱8,000 kada buwan; pagkatapos, ₱10 kada cash-in.

question: Magkano ang fee sa cash out sa branch?
answer: ₱20 kada cash-out.

question: Anong oras bukas ang branch tuwing Sabado?
answer: Karamihan ay bukas mula 8:00 a.m. hanggang 6:00 p.m.

question: Paano makausap ang customer service?
answer: Mag-chat sa app sa ilalim ng Help o pumunta sa branch; may sumasagot araw-araw mula 7:00 a.m. hanggang 10:00 p.m.
